description: Response Utility Library is a library designed for streamlined handling of response results, supporting success, error, and data outcomes in .NET applications. Within this library, the ResultHandler project serves as a versatile utility for managing result handling and responses efficiently across different use cases.
releaseNotes:
v16.0 - Breaking (serialization): a serialized result writes "errors" as the field-to-messages map Problem Details use ("" for messages without a field) and no longer writes "fieldErrors". Breaking (API): IOperationResult.Errors is the field-to-messages map ("" for messages without a field), replacing the flat Errors list, FieldErrors, IHasFieldErrors and GetFieldErrors(); the 1xx factories and UseProxy are removed. New: IOperationResult.Location, WithLocation(uri); redirect factories set Location. Versions move together; see CHANGELOG.md.

v15.0 - No changes in this package; ResponseResultHandler.AspNetCore adds an exception handler, async endpoint adapters and a smaller success envelope, and ResponseResultHandler.FluentValidation is new. Versions move together; see CHANGELOG.md.

v14.0.1 - No changes in this package; ResponseResultHandler.AspNetCore fixes MVC validation failures losing "errors". Versions move together.

v14.0 - Breaking: IOperationResult.Code added. New WithCode(code) attaches a machine-readable error code, serialized as "code" and carried through Map/Bind/ToErrorDataResult. Versions move together; see CHANGELOG.md.

v13.3 - No changes in this package; ResponseResultHandler.AspNetCore adds ProducesEnveloped() for OpenAPI. Versions move together.

v13.2 - No changes in this package; ResponseResultHandler.AspNetCore adds ProducesResultProblems() for OpenAPI. Versions move together.

v13.1 - Bind into commands that return no data:

Added:
- Bind/BindAsync overloads whose binder returns a result with no data (IOperationResult, or Task<OperationResult> such as a MediatR command Send), so a data result chains into a command in one expression. Failures keep title, status, detail, errors and field errors. Existing overloads are unchanged.

See CHANGELOG.md for full details.

v13.0 (breaking) - Result facade returns the common base types, plus async overloads for MediatR-style concrete results:

Changed (breaking):
- Every Result facade factory now returns OperationResult (was SuccessResult/ErrorResult) or OperationDataResult<T> (was SuccessDataResult<T>/ErrorDataResult<T>). Success and failure branches share one static type, so `cond ? Result.Success(x) : Result.NotFound<T>(...)` and lambdas returning both compile without casts or explicit type arguments. Runtime types are unchanged.
- Result.Created/Result.Accepted (and their <T> forms) are explicit overload pairs instead of an optional title parameter; existing calls compile unchanged.
- Binary breaking: assemblies compiled against 12.x must be recompiled.

Added:
- MapAsync/BindAsync/MatchAsync/OnSuccessAsync/OnFailureAsync/EnsureAsync overloads for Task<OperationDataResult<T>> and Task<OperationResult> sources (for example a MediatR Send), and BindAsync binders returning Task<OperationDataResult<TOut>>.

Migration: change variables, return types or delegates declared as a concrete subclass (ErrorResult e = Result.Conflict(...), Func<string, ErrorResult>) to OperationResult/OperationDataResult<T> or use var. See CHANGELOG.md for full details.

v12.1 - Per-field validation errors, plus FieldErrors bug fixes:

Added:
- Per-field validation errors: IHasFieldErrors, IResultFailureFactory<TSelf>.Failure(fieldErrors), OperationResult.Failure(fieldErrors) (see README "Per-field validation errors"). Breaking for any external IResultFailureFactory<TSelf> implementer - see CHANGELOG.md.

Fixed:
- Map/Bind/ToErrorDataResult() dropped FieldErrors when re-projecting a failure into a different result type - now preserved, along with the original Errors list.
- Result.Combine(...) dropped FieldErrors when merging failures - field errors from every combined failure are now merged by key.
- Failure(fieldErrors) threw if the dictionary had a null value - that field's messages are skipped instead.
- GetHashCode() was order-sensitive for FieldErrors while Equals() wasn't, so equal-content dictionaries with a different key order could hash differently.
- OperationResult/OperationDataResult<T>'s errors+fieldErrors constructor is now public, so Native AOT source-generated JSON deserializers can call it.

Removed (breaking):
- net7.0 support (EOL) - net8.0/net9.0/net10.0 only; upgrade your target framework before taking this version.

See CHANGELOG.md for full details.

v12 (breaking): Removed all members previously marked [Obsolete] — StatusMessage, StatusCode, ResultData, and every HttpStatusCode-based constructor across OperationResult/OperationDataResult/SuccessResult/SuccessDataResult/ErrorResult/ErrorDataResult. Use Title/Status/Data and the ResultStatus-based constructors instead (see README "Migrating to v12"). Also includes the previously-unreleased v11.1 additions: Result.Combine, Ensure/EnsureAsync guard clauses, and Task-aware async composition helpers (MatchAsync/OnSuccessAsync/OnFailureAsync/MapAsync/BindAsync). See CHANGELOG.md for details.
